title: Strict finite augmented Koszul tensor towers commute with completed inverse image
statement: Let J and K be small sites, L a finite-limit-preserving left adjoint between their sheaves of sets, and F its algebraic inverse-image data [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal and c:F(B_J)→B_K the canonical completed coefficient comparison. Suppose c is invertible. For a finite list a in A, let T_J and T_K be the actual strict dual Koszul tensor tower functors [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system] over B_J and B_K. The ordinary module inverse image P along c induces a natural isomorphism T_J followed by degreewise tower pullback ≅ degreewise complex pullback followed by T_K. At every tower index and complex degree, it carries P of the tensor coaugmentation to the target tensor coaugmentation. No inverse limits, exactness of countable products, derived category, ideal-generation or Noetherian hypothesis is involved.

proof.text: Obtain the normalized total tensor comparison on complexes and its ring-complex comparison j.
Identify the bounded dual Koszul tower under degreewise inverse image, with dual units normalized by that same j.

At N and tower level m compose the total tensor comparison with tensoring by the dual-tower comparison. Naturality in m follows from the second-variable tensor naturality and the dual-tower naturality. Transpose into complexes of towers degreewise. First-variable tensor naturality gives naturality in N. For the coaugmentation, use second-variable naturality on the dual unit, the dual-unit comparison equation, and the normalized inverse-right-unitor equation.

theorem strictCompletedKoszulTowerPullback
    {C D : Type v} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {L : Sheaf J (Type v) ⥤ Sheaf K (Type v)}
    (F : InverseImageData L) (V : Sheaf K (Type v) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type v))
    (adj : L ⊣ V) [PreservesFiniteLimits L]
    (A : Type v) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [IsIso (completedMap F A I)]
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) :
    let P := pull F (completedMap F A I)
    let TX := ringedKoszulTensorTowerFunctor (completed J A I) r
      (fun i ↦ algebraSection (baseMap J A I true) (a i))
    let TS := ringedKoszulTensorTowerFunctor (completed K A I) r
      (fun i ↦ algebraSection (baseMap K A I true) (a i))
    ∃ h : TX ⋙ ((Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ _ _).obj P).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ) ≅ P.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ TS,
      ∀ (N : Cx (completed J A I)) (m : ℕᵒᵖ) (n : ℤ),
        P.map ((ringedKoszulTensorUnitComponent (completed J A I) r
          (fun i ↦ algebraSection (baseMap J A I true) (a i)) N m).f n) ≫
            ((h.hom.app N).f n).app m =
          (ringedKoszulTensorUnitComponent (completed K A I) r
            (fun i ↦ algebraSection (baseMap K A I true) (a i))
            ((P.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N) m).f n
